limits: The actual ARM user-emulation check exercises only the non-PID1 refusal before root/FD/cleanup operations.
Cleanup, old-root emptiness, target-entry shape and subsequent V3 boot are not exercised by this negative test.
The original C implementation is preserved outside marker/length/comment substitutions, but source preservation is not a new runtime pass.
The C target check is size/shape, not content authentication; independent archive and VM profile hashes remain required.
The original V1 waiter and its actual positive/failed VM histories remain separate and immutable.
